report.summary: The diff adds a log line to artifactToken that passes the plaintext Artifacts token (issued.plaintext) as a log field. The log helper currently masks it only because the key is named 'token'. Handing a secret to a logger goes against CLAUDE.md rule 9, and any rename of the field would leak a live credential. The field always prints '[redacted]', so it does nothing for debugging expired clones. Remove the token from the log call and keep only non-secret fields (repo, scope, expiresAt).

findings.text: The log call passes `token: issued.plaintext`, the live Artifacts git token, to the logger. CLAUDE.md rule 9 says never put a secret in logs. Today redactFields masks it only because the key matches SECRET_FIELD (/token|key|.../i). Renaming or nesting it under a key such as 'credential', 'value' or 'plaintext' would write the plaintext token to Workers logs. The field also always prints '[redacted]', so it gives no debugging value. Remove the token field entirely and log only repo, scope and expiresAt (and, if useful, whether the cache was hit or missed).

No test covers the new log line (rule 14). Add a test that captures log output when a token is issued and asserts the plaintext token never appears in it, so a later field rename can't leak the secret without a failing test.

The relative `../log.ts` import is placed above the package imports (@tempo/protocol, effect), against the file's existing order. Move it next to the other relative import (`../env.ts`) so `bun run lint` stays clean.
